message: 努力の動力

name: Paqy
message: 「Yo, Lord Synn, why'd we come back to the library again?」

name: Synn
message: 「I wanted to try looking for books about demons one more time.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You already looked into it with the Student Council before and didn't find much, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Even so, better safe than sorry. Besides, I want to read through any books written about Ryuusei Academy, too.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Come to think of it, Petanko was sayin' a huge horde of demons is swarming the academy.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Alright! If I dig through a bunch of reference books, something might jog my memory. Let's head in.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn, soba back in the old days must've tasted awful.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Instead of boiling the noodles like we do now, they used to steam them in a bamboo steamer. That just makes them dry and crumbly--a total waste of buckwheat flour!」
The moment I sat down at a reading table, Nanaka--who had walked up without me noticing--spoke to me.

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, hey, Nanaka. You came to the library too?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What about you, Synn? Aren't you here for the exact same reason as me? Looking for books on demons, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's right, so why are you carrying a book on soba folklore and a history of sweets?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tahahaha! It's like a warm-up before I dive into the real research, you know?」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's a pretty weak excuse.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm not slacking off! Once I get into proper reading mode, I'll look into demons and Ryuusei Academy!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I'm counting on you.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Really?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka's concentration is even better than mine. Think about it--she's studied with the bustle of the shopping district in her ears ever since she was little.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Mufufu, leave it to my childhood friend. You know me so well.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's just that Nanaka tends to overcharge while gearing up for the main event, and ends up short-circuiting.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shut up! Don't build me up just to tear me down!」
Having unexpectedly met up with Nanaka, we began our research in the library.

name: Nanaka
message: 「I wonder if they have sweets in the Demon World too?」
Nanaka asks while skimming through the history of sweets.

name: Synn
message: 「I'm sure there must be」

name: Synn
message: 「Watching Sally-chan, it's obvious that Demons get hungry too and collapse if they don't eat, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「There have to be little kids too, so I bet there are sweets in the Demon World」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then that means the Demon World has home cooking too, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What if the Crusaders recreate the taste of Demon World mom's cooking and treat the Demons to a feast?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If we did that, wouldn't the Demons causing trouble in the Human World get homesick and go back to the Demon World?」

name: Paqy
message: 「It sounds absurd, but as psychological warfare, it's extremely effective」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka...」
Nanaka's proposal warms my heart.
Even if I revealed my true identity, wouldn't Nanaka accept me?

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, um...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn? Making a serious face all of a sudden--are you planning to tease me again?」

name: Synn
message: 「T-That sweet looks delicious」
Unable to bring myself to say it after all, I drop my gaze to the page of the book Nanaka has open.

name: Nanaka
message: 「This?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, that barmkuchen」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey now. Not barm, it's baumkuchen!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah」
A large illustration is drawn on the page, explaining how baumkuchen was made over a hundred years ago.

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, you coat a spit with batter over a flame and spin it around and around to bake it firm... and repeating that creates those tree rings」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You bet. And then at the end, you pull out the spit and slice up the thickly baked dough, and it turns into the baumkuchen shape we know」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You have to keep rotating the spit the whole time while making it, so it's pretty heavy labor...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, ack! Back in the old days, a doggy was the power source!?」
Examining the illustration closely, an object resembling an enlarged hamster wheel was connected to the end of the spit. Inside it, a dog is running with all its might.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ho-ho, the cooking method itself is simple. Maybe I'll make this our booth for next year's KiraFes. Looks like Yumil could even do it alone」

name: Paqy
message: 「Soba. If you used a pooch like that nowadays, animal welfare groups wouldn't stay quiet, you know?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, right... Then what should we do?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Huh? It's Nana-chan. Synn-kun's here too. Hellooo」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, it's a power source」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, yeah, totally a power source」

name: Paqy
message: 「Definitely a power source」

name: Sacchin
message: 「W-What, what, what is going on?」
After chatting quietly so as not to disturb the other library patrons, we got down to business and started our research.
With Sacchin helping out too, we searched through various books on Ryuusei Academy and Demons, yet...
...We didn't really find anything new.
